trials.claimQuote:
### Brandy: $49 (was $1050)
- Lifetime access to Brandy Plan
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm paying a single lifetime price for the tool, and the prosecution exhibits are only speculation about future survival, not evidence that lifetime access was denied.

exhibits.quote: With that said, I'm 99% sure this project has been abandoned.
exhibits.argument: Abandonment reports undermine the promise that lifetime access will remain usable.

exhibits.quote: It does not give me confidence that it will last after the AppSumo promotion is over.
exhibits.argument: Doubt about survival after promotion undermines lifetime access to the Brandy Plan.

exhibits.quote: Everything is so expensive right now, and I'm thankful to have the opportunity to pay a single price and have a great tool to share clients' branding with them.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms paying a single price for ongoing access to the tool.

exhibits.quote: I am willing to live with this compromise for the moment with the lifetime pricing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase was lifetime pricing.

trials.claim: Lifetime access to all PRO features
trials.claimQuote:

- Unlimited assets
- Unlimited users
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm the deal activates the Pro Plan; the features cited as missing are Business Plan features, not PRO features, so they do not contradict access to all PRO features.

exhibits.quote: It is true that the AppSumo deal does not include every feature, but considering the price, it offers great value.
exhibits.argument: Admission that not every feature is included contradicts lifetime access to all PRO features.

exhibits.quote: These features are only available in the Business Plan ($350 per year) and not in the Pro Plan ($50 per year) offered on AppSumo.
exhibits.argument: Key features being Business-only contradicts that the deal includes all PRO features.

exhibits.quote: Had a small issue with my account being activated in the free plan instead of the pro plan, but their support responded and immediately corrected the issue.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the deal provides access to the pro plan.
